title: Made an .io browser game with Codex - Wreckr.io
author: ozeppo
selftext:
So... I just spent my last weekend with Codex and ended up making a little browser .io game called Wreckr.io. The idea was pretty simple: make a little game with car and car-like steering and mix it with something like diep.io. It's multiplayer, but I also added bots so the arena isn't completely empty when nobody's playing now.

Honestly, it started as a next random weekend experiment, but to my surprise, it turned out much better than I thought, and the short sessions ranging from 30 seconds to 2 minutes started to draw me in.

Still a lot of things to improve, especially sounds, but it's been really interesting seeing that you can make a whole game with Codex in just a couple of days.

Anyway, I'd appreciate it if you could test it and give me some feedback - [https://wreckr.io](https://wreckr.io)
